# filemanager_swift_operation (Resource)

Performs operations on OpenStack Swift objects such as head, copy, or set metadata.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `object_path` (String) Path to the object in the Swift container.
- `operation` (String) Operation to perform. Valid values: head, copy, set_metadata.
- `service` (String) Swift service alias (from filemanager_swift_service resource).

### Optional

- `destination_path` (String) Destination path for copy operation.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata to set on the object (for set_metadata operation).

### Read-Only

- `content_type` (String) Content type of the object.
- `current_metadata` (Map of String) Current metadata on the object.
- `etag` (String) Entity tag (hash) of the object.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the resource.
- `is_dir` (Boolean) Whether the path is a directory.
- `last_modified` (String) Last modification time of the object.
- `name` (String) Base name of the object.
- `size` (Number) Size of the object in bytes.
